sound.bed: suspense pulse 132 BPM, louder for the final, stops at the win
sound.rolling: noise through wood resonances 620/1250/2950/6200 Hz following each marble's speed
sound.hits: clacks between marbles, knocks off the rim and pegs, a G6/B6/D7 bell per peg when it lights up
sound.drop: a hollow plonk, falling clacks and a two-note stinger
sound.final: riser and ding at FINAL 2!, heartbeat during the duel, whoosh at the cuts
sound.winner: brass fanfare, crash, six claps, then a happy loop at 118 BPM
